description: RESEARCH-ONLY (is_gate:false, routes_in_production:false, un-wired). Narrow EIP-4626 share-accounting defect detector. In an ERC-4626 vault context, flags the mechanism-clear sub-shape where a max/limit/preview function uses an APPROXIMATE convertToAssets/convertToShares (or wraps an external maxRedeem/maxDeposit in convertTo*) instead of the EIP-4626-mandated exact preview* — causing max*/preview* to over- or under-report (4626 non-compliance / integration breakage / value mis-report). Two-signal gate: S1 is-4626 context + S2 convertTo*-in-max/limit/preview misuse. Anchor: PoolTogether M-02 (PrizeVault._maxYieldVaultWithdraw = yieldVault.convertToAssets(maxRedeem())). Kept NARROW (precision over recall): does NOT flag benign rounding, caller-only loss, documented behavior, or non-4626 contracts.

fp_controls.two_signal_required: S1 is-4626 vault context AND S2 a max/limit/preview function body using approximate convertToAssets/convertToShares (EIP-4626 requires exact preview* in these). Non-4626 contracts and 4626 vaults that correctly use preview* are suppressed.
fp_controls.narrow_scope: only the convert-in-max/limit/preview sub-shape is HIGH; preview/action rounding-direction divergence is MEDIUM (precision risk). Generic vault rounding is NOT flagged.
fp_controls.documented_suppression: explicit '1:1'/'same value as'/documented preview behavior near the function -> suppressed.
